model.title: Chiricahua National Park Act
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. Mark Kelly (D-AZ)

summary.text: The bill would redesignate Chiricahua National Monument in Arizona as a national park. It would require the National Park Service to protect Native American traditional cultural and religious sites within the park and allow tribal members access for traditional and customary uses, with the ability to temporarily close specific park areas to the public when requested by an Indian tribe for these purposes.
